info.name: Finalysis API
info.description:
Requests for the Finalysis backend, with tests. Run top to bottom against the local dev app (`./mvnw spring-boot:run`, **without** the `aws` profile) on a **freshly reset** dev database (`scripts/reset-dev-db.sh`): setup creates the accounts, so a second run fails. File uploads use paths relative to the repo root: run newman from there, or set Postman's working directory (Settings → General) to the repo root.

**The newman run** is folders 1–6, **8. Categorization**, **9. Analytics** and **12. Chat (AI off)**, selected with `--folder` (the README gives the command). They use only fictional sample data and expect AI to be off: every AI request asserts `status: OFF` and 0 calls, so none can reach Bedrock.

**Left out of the newman run** (leave out their `--folder`, or untick them in the Collection Runner):
- **7. Real-file test**: manual runs with your own file, selected in Postman.
- **10. Lookups**: manual lookups by id.
- **11. Live AI (aws profile)**: needs the backend started with `SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=aws` and makes live Bedrock calls. Any request that needs the `aws` profile goes in this folder, never in the newman folders.

**Scripts.** The Postman sandbox's global `_` is **Lodash 3**: functions added in Lodash 4 (`minBy`, `maxBy`, `sumBy`, …) don't exist there, so scripts use plain JavaScript or Lodash 3 only. In **8. Categorization**, and in **9. Analytics** after its imports, each subfolder's first request arms a flag and every pick checks what it found; after a failed pick the subfolder's later requests are skipped (`pm.execution.skipRequest`, newman 6.1 or later), so one bad pick is one failure, not a cascade.
